meta.title: Whooping Cranes: From 21 to 830 in a Century #shorts
meta.description:
The whooping crane population grew from just 21 birds to over 830 thanks to conservation. About 560 migrate each year from Texas to Canada’s Northwest Territories. Roughly 140 breed in Wisconsin and Louisiana, with 130 kept in captivity to preserve genetics.

📚 Source: Whooping crane — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whooping_crane

ℹ️ This video was researched from the cited source and produced with AI-assisted scripting and a synthetic narrator voice. Facts are checked against the source before publishing.

script.title: Whooping Cranes: From 21 to 830 in a Century

segments.text: Did you know whooping cranes once vanished to just 21 birds?
Those 21 gave hope when conservation saved them from extinction.
Today, over 830 cranes roam North America, thanks to reintroduction programs.
About 560 migrate yearly between Texas and Canada’s Northwest Territories.
segments.evidence: about 560 individuals in the remnant population that migrates

segments.text: Another 140 breed in Wisconsin and Louisiana, keeping the species thriving.
segments.evidence: about 140 individuals in two reintroduced populations breeding

segments.text: A further 130 remain in captivity, ensuring a genetic reservoir.
